notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis, Total column (pp4-5); spending is listed by object only, so statement lines use general government with review. Sale of assets and interest income are printed as nonoperating revenues below Total revenues (outside_printed_total). Beginning/ending cash = total governmental fund balance (1,208,690 beginning; restated +10,000 for a duplicate keno transfer; 1,460,175 ending), which includes 70,486 due from Water and Sewer. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7, Total column), measure net position; proprietary cash-flow statement (pp8-9) not recorded because basis is cash (operating 264,440, noncapital 123,992, capital -245,781, investing 11,228, cash 1,761,258 -> 1,915,137). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1) since it carries capital assets and debt. Detail: the General Fund departments combining statement (pp11-12) recorded per department column; the all-funds budgetary comparison (p10) combines every fund by function and cannot be assigned to individual funds, so only its per-fund function lines for funds without their own schedule (Streets, Keno, Economic Development, Water, Wastewater, Sanitation expenditures, p10) are recorded; its revenue, debt service and transfer lines combine all funds (including the General Fund) and cannot be assigned to individual funds, so they are not recorded.
